content.text: Xo Kitty Season 3: Release Date, Cast, Plot, and All You Need to KnowNetflix‘s teen rom-com hit Xo Kitty is officially returning for a third season. Production is now wrapped as of July 2025. Season 3 was announced on Valentine’s Day with a playful Instagram video featuring Anna Cathcart, who stars as Kitty Song Covey. With filming completed and the post-production phase underway, Season 3 is expected to premiere in early 2026.The upcoming season picks up after Season 2’s cliffhanger, where Kitty confessed her feelings to Min Ho just before summer break. The series, a spin-off of Jenny Han’s adaptation of the To All the Boys I’ve Loved Before movie series, has carved its own identity. With a significant teen fanbase, the show successfully combines K-drama tropes with heartfelt coming-of-age themes, romance, and friendship.
